tandemFrageBeispiel.antwort: Vivia numa aldeia perto de Viseu.

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “O que estavas a fazer quando o telefone tocou?” (Put the verb in the right form.)

B hears the question and builds the answer. Decide between the two past tenses. The perfeito says what happened, one event after another: cheguei, tocou. The imperfeito describes the background, habits and what was going on: fazia frio, vivia, dormia. A tile in brackets such as (eu) says who is meant; you don’t write it.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p1: Número 1: O que estavas a fazer …?

tandemRedemittel.p2: Perfeito: aconteceu (cheguei). Imperfeito: cenário, hábito (fazia frio).
